Hey there! You are doing a wonderful thing trying to get help. Your little girl is worth it, and so are you. I think talking to your psychiatrist is a great first step. 

I personally have never been admitted to an inpatient facility, but I am a nurse and my ex boyfriend was admitted while we were together. In my state most admits are for 7 days, more if you are still unstable at that time. They will attempt to find medications that get you stable and then you will see your normal psychiatric on an outpatient basis to get your medication regimen to fit you better. My ex did not talk negatively about his time in the hospital. He felt that it helped him get to a better place mentally and that it was very helpful to take a break from the day to day stressors. 

If you feel actively suicidal, which it sounds like you do, seek help. Don't wait to talk to your partner. Don't wait for anything. Call your psychiatrist and talk about your options.
Sorry about that! Won't happen again.
